---
title: "Skittles Analysis"
format: html
---

Load in Data:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/skittles.csv"
skittles=read.csv(df_url)
head(skittles)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  Student Red Orange Yellow Green Purple
1       1   2      1      5     5      1
2       2   0      2      6     1      5
3       3   0      3      4     3      4
4       4   2      5      4     1      3
5       5   0      4      6     3      3
6       6   4      5      3     3      3
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
totals=colSums(skittles[,2:6])
barplot(totals)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](skoittlesExploration_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


Expected Totals


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
n=sum(totals)
expected=rep(n/5,5)
expected
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 26.8 26.8 26.8 26.8 26.8
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
totals
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
   Red Orange Yellow  Green Purple 
    11     31     39     25     28 
```


:::
:::


Model Evaluation


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rmse_observed=sqrt(mean((totals-expected)^2))
rmse_observed
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 9.173876
```


:::
:::


Simulating machines


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
colors=c("red","orange","yellow","green","purple")
s=sample(colors,n,replace=TRUE)
table(s)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
s
 green orange purple    red yellow 
    33     30     30     18     23 
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
rmse_machine=sqrt(mean((table(s)-expected)^2))
rmse_machine
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 5.491812
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rmse=function(s){
  sqrt(mean((table(s)-expected)^2))
}

rmse_machines=replicate(10000,
                        rmse(sample(colors,n,replace=TRUE))
                        )
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hist(rmse_machines)
abline(v=rmse_observed,col="darkred")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](skoittlesExploration_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
sum(rmse_machines>=rmse_observed)/10000 # p-value
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 0.0044
```


:::
:::


$\chi^2$ Goodness of Fit Test

Uses theoretical reference distribution: Chi-square with $k-1$ degrees of freedom where $k$ = number of categories (5 for skittles).


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
chi=sum((totals-expected)^2/expected)
chi
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 15.70149
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
1-pchisq(chi,4) #Prob that a chi-square with 4 df > chi
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 0.003447022
```


:::
:::
